executive_summary: Highest leverage: consolidate account authorization checks duplicated across 3 high-churn route handlers with diverging edge cases.
Smallest safe first step: add characterization tests for the 3 routes, then extract a single requireAccountAccess helper without changing HTTP semantics.
Low-risk tooling win next: expose the checked-in client generator as a package script so reviewers can verify generated diffs mechanically.

findings.title: Centralize repeated account authorization

evidence.note: Similar ownership check returning 404 instead of 403 on mismatch.
Third copy with an extra role branch omitted from accounts.ts.

findings.current_cost: Security-sensitive authorization rules must be patched across 3 route files, and error/admin edge cases have already diverged.
findings.interest_rate_reason: Touched in 11 commits (4 fix commits) over 6 months; accounts.ts and billing.ts co-changed in 5 commits.
findings.payoff: One trusted auth boundary prevents repeated permission bugs and makes new routes safe by default.
findings.falsification: Checked auth middleware, route callers, and git log -n 5 across all 3 files; no ADR documents intentional status-code divergence.
findings.slice: Add characterization tests locking current responses for all 3 routes, then extract requireAccountAccess without altering status codes.
findings.why_this_order: Highest interest rate on a security-critical boundary with a clean bounded first slice.

gate.expected: all existing and new route characterization tests pass

findings.fix_risk_reason: Live route HTTP error status semantics must stay backward-compatible for clients.
findings.confidence_reason: Verified all 3 route handlers directly and ran the existing auth suite.

findings.title: Document and wire generated client regeneration
findings.category: Tooling, CI, and Developer Workflow Debt

evidence.note: Generated output is checked into git.
No script exposes the generator or verifies cleanliness in CI.

findings.current_cost: Reviewers cannot reproduce generated client diffs or verify that checked-in client code matches the schema.
findings.interest_rate_reason: src/generated/client.ts changed in 6 API PRs over the last quarter with manual regeneration notes.
findings.payoff: Regeneration becomes a one-command check that CI can enforce automatically.
findings.falsification: Checked package.json, Makefile, and .github/workflows; no hidden CI step invokes scripts/generate-client.ts.
findings.slice: Add a generate:client script in package.json, document it in README, and verify git diff --exit-code.
findings.why_this_order: Small, low-risk tooling fix that eliminates recurring PR review friction.

gate.expected: exits 0 with no unstaged diff against checked-in client

findings.fix_risk_reason: Package script wiring and docs only; no runtime behavior change.
findings.confidence_reason: Generator, checked-in output, and package.json were all verified directly.

investigate.signal: Similar fixture factories exist in two route test directories.
investigate.proof_needed: Compare recent test failure history and fixture edit co-changes.

rejected.title: src/generated/client.ts size
rejected.reason: Large file, but generated output rather than hand-maintained debt.

implementer_notes: Start with characterization tests for current authorization behavior before extracting helpers.
Keep generated-file script wiring in a separate commit from route behavior changes.
